title: LOADBench: A Large Open Analog Dataset and Benchmark for Machine Learning in IC Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.21591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) for analog IC design is constrained by limited open data and the absence of standardized evaluation: results reported in different papers are typically obtained on bespoke, often closed, datasets and with ad-hoc metrics, leaving comparisons across methods unreliable. We address both gaps with a large opensource dataset and a suite of standardized benchmarks. The dataset contains more than 100 operational amplifier (opamp) topologies (1-, 2-, and 3-stage) in the SkyWater130 PDK, each shipped with structural and functional annotations, topology-specific sizing constraints (symmetry and sizing rules), an Ngspice testbench, and a multi-objective NSGA-II sizing run producing around 103 Pareto-optimal and 106 intermediate sizing-performance pairs per topology. translated_title: LOADBench：一个面向集成电路设计中机器学习的大型开放模拟数据集与基准测试
translated_abstract: 面向模拟集成电路（IC）设计的机器学习（ML）受限于有限的开放数据以及标准化评估的缺失：不同论文中报告的结果通常是在定制的、且往往是封闭的数据集上，通过特定的指标获得的，导致跨方法的比较不可靠。我们通过一个大型开源数据集和一套标准化基准来弥补这两个不足。该数据集包含SkyWater130工艺设计套件（PDK）中100多种运算放大器（opamp）拓扑（单级、两级和三级），每种拓扑都附带结构和功能注释、特定于拓扑的尺寸约束（对称性和尺寸规则）、Ngspice测试台，以及多目标NSGA-II尺寸优化运行结果，每种拓扑产生约10³个帕累托最优和10⁶个中间的尺寸-性能数据对。基于这些数据，我们定义了六个具有精确协议的基准任务：逆向尺寸设计、拓扑选择、子电路分类、结构电路生成等。
tldr: 该论文提出LOADBench——一个包含SkyWater130工艺下100多种运算放大器拓扑及大规模尺寸-性能数据的大型开源模拟数据集，并配套六个标准化基准任务，解决了模拟IC设计机器学习领域开放数据匮乏和评估标准缺失的两大难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LOADBench, a large open-source analog dataset featuring 100+ opamp topologies in SkyWater130 with extensive sizing-performance data, along with six standardized benchmark tasks to address the lack of open data and standardized evaluation in machine learning for analog IC design.
